purchase_option_enrichment.comparison_rule: refresh current commercial fields, compare fixed Steam Sub packages across at least two visible base-game families by exact appid or explicit purchase equivalence, and add only verified priced top-level DLC/content attached to those covered games; unpriced/unknown/nonpersonalized content has zero ranking value; Taste source remains independent
purchase_option_enrichment.ranking_stage_requirement: commercial refresh and complete-content package enrichment before the single final ranking pass

production_contract.fixed_package_purchase_option_rule: fixed Sub only; >=2 visible base-game families by exact appid or explicit verified purchase equivalence; relevant package information may be displayed without strict savings; ranking boost remains fail-closed and requires the commercial package route to satisfy ranking policy; personalized bundles excluded
production_contract.direct_user_evidence_rule: adjusts fit/bucket upstream; not a second final sort factor
production_contract.windows_rule: legacy Steam XP/7/8 requirement label alone is neutral; only confirmed modern-Windows friction may penalize
production_contract.ui_manual_end_rule: local explicit end-of-queue override is applied by UI after production priority_rank
production_contract.backtracking_rule: location reuse itself is neutral; penalize unchanged repetition without new gameplay value
production_contract.card_explanation_rule: positive requires specific Taste evidence; visible negative requires grounded provenance; scoring/ranking semantics unchanged
production_contract.play_priority_context_rule: play role and relative start priority are producer-owned semantic context; they do not change eligibility, fit, sale urgency, total_score, priority_rank, or create a second sorter
